text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "These agreements establish internal market conditions in a number of sectors, thus removing or reducing discriminatory treatment and barriers to trade between Switzerland and the EU.", "gist": "Agreements create fair market conditions and reduce trade barriers between Switzerland and the EU."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "1972", "gist": "Year the Free Trade Agreement was concluded"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "seven", "gist": "Number of agreements in the first package"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "nine", "gist": "Number of agreements in the second package"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "After the Swiss electorate rejected membership of the European Economic Area (EEA) in 1992", "gist": "Switzerland and the EU signed bilateral agreements following EEA membership rejection in 1992"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "European Economic Area (EEA)", "gist": "A regional trade and economic agreement between the EU and some European countries"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Free Trade Agreement", "gist": "A trade agreement between Switzerland and the EU concluded in 1972"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "bilateral agreements", "gist": "Agreements between Switzerland and the EU"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "1999", "gist": "Year the first package of bilateral agreements was signed"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2004", "gist": "Year the second package of bilateral agreements was signed"}]}
